projectDescription: Design-Test-Driven Development (DTDD) is a methodology and installable plugin for AI coding agents that keeps a repository's design docs permanently in sync with its code — enforced by a commit gate, driven by a three-tier orchestration model, and structured around one component at a time.
keyFeatures: Maintained present-state DESIGN.md per component — read before every change, written after every change
Three-tier orchestration model: Principal Orchestrator → DTDD Orchestrator → Component Workers
Stamp-gated pre-commit hook blocks commits until an independent design-sync review has run
Design-sync agent runs in fresh context to verify doc↔code fidelity without author bias
/dtdd-init scaffolds the full methodology into any repo in one command, non-destructively
/dtdd-goal drives a multi-stage spec to completion, absorbing planning gates and always bringing commit gates to the human
Two-wave orchestration: read-only plan wave then execute wave, with seam detection from design docs only
Decisions log (permanent) and improvements log (transient) keep history separate from present-state docs
Design-derived tests: every stated invariant and pinned contract clause becomes at least one test case
Worked example (Orderflow) shows the full documentation structure for a realistic multi-service repo
publicApiSurface: /dtdd-init — scaffold DTDD into any repo (idempotent, non-destructive)
/dtdd <change> — run one design-driven repo-wide change with two human gates
/dtdd-goal <spec> — Principal Orchestrator: decompose a spec into stages and drive it to completion
dtdd-component agent — per-component worker running the 8-step DTDD loop (plan or execute mode)
design-sync agent — independent reviewer that syncs DESIGN.md files with staged code and creates the commit stamp
design-sync-gate.sh — PreToolUse hook that blocks git commit without a design-sync stamp
gate-test.sh — self-test for the commit gate hook
DESIGN.template.md — 12-section fixed template for every component design document
decisions-log.md template — permanent append-only log of confirmed decisions
improvements-log.md template — transient tracker of known-imperfect implementation areas
